screen.applet: from enigma import eSize, ePoint, getDesktop, eLabel deskwidth = getDesktop(0).size().width() deskheight = getDesktop(0).size().height() try: factor = float(deskwidth) / 1280.0 if deskwidth else 1.0 width = int(self.params.get('width', 300) * factor) height = int(self.params.get('height', 300) * factor) listsize = (width - int(20 * factor),height - int(70 * factor)) self["list"].instance.resize(eSize(*listsize)) titlesize = (width - int(20 * factor),int(40 * factor)) self["title"].instance.resize(eSize(*titlesize)) layersize = (width,height) self.instance.resize(eSize(*layersize)) self.instance.move(ePoint(int((deskwidth - width)/2),int((deskheight - height)/2))) for x in self.additionalWidgets: if isinstance(x.instance, eLabel): x.instance.resize(eSize(*layersize)) except: pass
